title: Markor 2.16.1 (flavorAtest debug build, net.gsantner.markor_test) trigger graph

screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher icon, widget, pinned shortcut, another app or file manager, adb broadcast
screens.S_EXIT: The process ends (Back out of the last activity, or the system kills the process)
screens.S_NOTEBOOK: MainActivity, notebook tab: the file browser of the notebook folder (GsFileBrowserFragment) with the FAB and the bottom navigation
screens.S_NOTEBOOK_SEL: MainActivity, notebook tab with a selection: one or more rows are selected (after a long-press on a row); the info item of the toolbar menu acts on the selection
screens.S_TODO: MainActivity, todo tab: DocumentEditAndViewFragment for the todo.txt file
screens.S_QUICKNOTE: MainActivity, quick note tab: DocumentEditAndViewFragment for the quick note file
screens.S_MORE: MainActivity, more tab: MoreFragment with the info and links of the app
screens.S_NEWFILE: NewFileDialog (opened by the FAB): name, type, template
screens.S_DOCUMENT: DocumentActivity with DocumentEditAndViewFragment (the editor or the viewer of one file); variants per open mode
screens.S_SHARE_INTO: DocumentActivity with DocumentShareIntoFragment (text or file shared into Markor, choose the target file)
screens.S_SHARE_PICKER: DocumentShareIntoFragment: the folder browser opened by the share import (OK chooses the folder for the shared file)
screens.S_SETTINGS: SettingsActivity root: settings list with sub-screens
screens.S_ACTION_BUTTONS: ActionButtonSettingsActivity: order of the editor action buttons
screens.S_INTRO: IntroActivity: the AppIntro slides shown on the first start
screens.S_PERMISSION: StoragePermissionActivity: the storage permission request dialog (the app cannot run without it)
screens.S_EXT_APP: Another app or system screen without a result (share chooser, browser, viewer)
screens.S_WIDGET_CONFIG: WrWidgetConfigure: configuration screen of a notebook widget
screens.S_HOME_WIDGET_NOTEBOOK: Launcher home screen with the Markor notebook widget (WrMarkorWidgetProvider: buttons and the file list)
screens.S_HOME_WIDGET_TODO: Launcher home screen with the Markor todo widget (TodoWidgetProvider: the todo list and its header)
